item.title: 36k-Mile 1993 Cadillac Sedan DeVille at No Reserve
item.description: This 1993 Cadillac Sedan DeVille shows 36k miles, and it has been registered in California since new. item.title: 31k-Mile 2009 Jaguar XF Luxury
item.description: This 2009 Jaguar XF Luxury was registered with one owner in Florida before it was relocated to New York in 2018, and it was subsequently acquired by the current owner. item.title: 1986 Ford F-150 XL at No Reserve
item.description: This 1986 Ford F-150 XL pickup has remained registered in California since new and is powered by a 4.9-liter inline-six that drives the rear wheels through a four-speed manual transmission. Finished in Silver Crystal, the car is equipped with Volvo electric power steering, a limited-slip differential, front disc brakes, a Heigo roll bar, rally bucket seats, and Bilstein shock absorbers. item.description: This 2009 Ford F-250 Lariat 4×4 is a SuperCab pickup that remained registered to the original owner in Nebraska through the seller's purchase in 2025 and now has 25k miles. item.title: 1992 BMW 325i Touring 5-Speed
item.description: This 1992 BMW 325i Touring was imported from Poland to the US following the selling dealer's recent acquisition. item.title: 1,380cc-Powered 1960 Morris Mini-Minor
item.description: This 1960 Morris Mini-Minor is a left-hand-drive example that underwent a repaint, an interior re-trim, and installation of a 1,380cc A-series inline-four as part of a refurbishment completed in the 1990s. Finished in red with a white roof, the car rides on 10″ Cosmic alloy wheels and is equipped with front disc brakes as well as Spax gas shocks. item.title: Holiday Insanity, Movie Cars, and Plymouth Connoisseurship
item.description: Happy Holidays to one and all! Alex, Randy, Beck, and Tyler discuss Hanukkah gifting strategies, holiday road trips in order of escalating insanity, movie-adjacent cars, wood paneling connoisseurship, ghosts of American car brands past, drift missiles, stalker Eagles, and generational headlight trauma.
